finding.claim: wipe() calls requireRole(u, "OWNER") but discards its boolean result, so any caller, including one with no roles, reaches repo.wipe(tenant) at line 27.
finding.source: Authenticated User passed to Admin.wipe(User u, String tenant) (src/Admin.java:25); tenant string is caller-chosen via POST /tenants/{t}/wipe.
finding.sink: repo.wipe(tenant) at src/Admin.java:27, an irreversible destructive operation.

trace.note: wipe(User u, String tenant) entered with caller's User
requireRole returns u.roles().contains(role) as boolean and does not throw

finding.guards_checked: requireRole (src/Admin.java:14-16) returns a boolean with no enforcement when ignored; checkRole (src/Admin.java:18-22) is the enforcing version but is not called in wipe; no authentication or tenant check in this file. Fix: use checkRole(u, "OWNER") at line 26, as export does at line 32.

verdict.guard_found: requireRole (src/Admin.java:14-16) returns a boolean and is called as a bare statement at line 26, so its result is discarded and it enforces nothing; checkRole (src/Admin.java:18-22) would throw but is not called in wipe(); no other guard exists in the repository (only src/Admin.java is present).
verdict.reason: At src/Admin.java:26 the boolean returned by requireRole (line 14-15) is discarded, so repo.wipe(tenant) at line 27 runs for any User passed into wipe(), including one with no OWNER role; the trace matches the code exactly. The only caveat is that the User is presumably authenticated upstream, which lies outside the repository, but that does not reduce the role-check failure, since the attacker only needs to be a low-privilege authenticated user.

finding.claim: Neither wipe nor export binds the caller to the target tenant. Roles are a flat Set<String> with no tenant, so an OWNER of one tenant can likely act on another (cross-tenant IDOR).
finding.source: Caller-chosen tenant argument combined with any OWNER role the caller holds.
finding.sink: repo.export(tenant) at src/Admin.java:33 and repo.wipe(tenant) at src/Admin.java:27.

trace.note: User is record User(String name, Set<String> roles); no tenant attribute
checkRole(u, "OWNER") verifies a global role only
repo.export(tenant) called with no caller-to-tenant check

finding.guards_checked: checkRole checks role only, not tenant membership. No tenant scoping in Admin.java. Repo implementation and upstream router are not in the directory, so this is unconfirmed and depends on them.

verdict.guard_found: Only role checks exist in src/Admin.java. checkRole (lines 18-22) throws on a missing role and gates export at line 32, but it checks roles only, not tenant. requireRole (lines 14-16) returns a bool that wipe discards at line 26, so wipe has no effective authorization at all. No tenant-membership check exists in this file.
verdict.reason: All trace lines match (User has no tenant field at src/Admin.java:4, export's only guard is checkRole at line 32, and tenant goes straight to repo.export at line 33). Whether an OWNER of one tenant can reach another depends on the Repo implementation and the upstream router, which are not in the directory, and the flat role set may already be scoped per tenant upstream. Separately, src/Admin.java:26 discards requireRole's boolean, so wipe at line 27 is unguarded for any authenticated caller, which is a more direct flaw than the cross-tenant claim.
